pattern.description: On the Roadmap board the presenter grabs the Onboarding templates card, lifts it out of the Later column and drops it into Next under Sorting capabilities; the Add MS teams function card below slides up to close the gap.
pattern.why_premium: A single direct-manipulation gesture shows prioritisation in action: the lifted card, the reflowing column and the drop all read clearly at the pushed-in scale, so the board's value is demonstrated rather than described.

build_hint.gsap: Timeline: gsap.to('.card-onboarding', {scale: 1.02, boxShadow: '0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18)', duration: 0.12, ease: 'power2.out'}) then .to('.card-onboarding', {x: dx, y: dy, duration: 0.55, ease: 'power2.inOut'}) with the cursor following on the same tween; at drop .to('.card-onboarding', {scale: 1, boxShadow: 'none', duration: 0.15}) and, starting when the card leaves, gsap.to('.card-msteams', {y: -gapHeight, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power3.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Drive card x/y with interpolate(frame, [lift, drop], [from, to], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad)}) and cursor on the same path; lift/drop scale with spring({frame: frame - lift, fps, config: {damping: 18, stiffness: 260}}); the lower card's translateY = interpolate(spring({frame: frame - lift - 3, fps, config: {damping: 22, stiffness: 180}}), [0, 1], [0, -gapHeight]).

notes: This is a live drag in the screen recording, so the card path is hand-driven (jittery energy with several sub-peaks) and easing is ambiguous. No taxonomy pattern is drag-and-drop specific; cursor_guided_demo is the closest, but a 'card drag reorder' pattern could be worth proposing. No SFX candidates.
